scope: Existing 682 advisor records only; profileUrl, labUrl and openingDetails.sources; read-only public research; no new advisors, no application submissions.
method: Static HTML scan for literal 2028 or 28年/28级/28Fall; PDF text extraction where retrieved. Year matches are candidates, not admissions claims. Additionally 56 targeted search queries across all existing institutions; important admissions candidates manually reviewed in first-party text/HTML. HTTP 200 is retrieval only, not full individual verification.
limitations: Timeouts, non-200 responses, blank or JS-only pages and stale/invalid pages remain unverified.
A 200 body can be a page shell or an error page. The at-least-150-character metric is a volume metric, not proof of a valid faculty page.
Static text scanning does not exhaust dynamic content, linked subpages, relative-year statements, alternate Chinese year spellings or newly created sources.
Targeted search was not a manual page-by-page audit of all 682 advisors. No new evidence found does not mean other advisors do not recruit.
No change to catalog recruitment flags or source check dates; manual rechecks are documented here separately.
